purpose: Map one frozen descriptive D versus V close-MAE20 question onto the existing Factor Lab workflow without granting real X or Y.

existing_entry.reason: Validator lacks a descriptive D/V rank comparison and preflight computes or demands Y before execution reservation; generic MAE can skip a halt.

fixed_question.period_start_reason: Cannot bind earliest frozen case without deduplicated-cases.json.
fixed_question.candidate_D: (A_signal_close-C_event)/ATR20_SMA; reuse saved frozen D rather than regenerate
fixed_question.target_price_basis: unchanged saved economic close; retrospective price-path measure only
fixed_question.comparison: per-asset average-tied-rank signed Spearman rho(D,Y), rho(V,Y), difference on identical complete cases; equal mean over fixed common computable assets
fixed_question.sensitivity: exactly 33 leave-one-asset-lifecycle-out summaries, same saved labels, fixed initial asset set, no rescue selection

75 full 21-close paths before any Y output; one frozen unknown
one explicit halt or gap rejects the whole planned label batch
non-boolean action_known rejects when the field is supplied
V result itself must be finite after arithmetic
D/V same-case and fixed-asset rank comparison
